title: Sam Moran and Dawson on bass at Tom Anderson's with Frank Keelan
summary: When bassist Sam Moran fell ill, Dawson took his place in Tom Brown's band at Tom Anderson's, with Frank Keelan on muted trumpet, mandolin, two guitars and no drum.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What about Sam Moran? You remember him?

Sam, uh, Sam Moran was a bass player. Now, he played, he played X-ray with Tom Brown at, uh, at Tom Anderson. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. I, I, I believe I, I took, I took his place one time, and I remember the last, the last winding up of, of Tom Anderson, uh, Sam Moran got his, health got bad. And he's living on Gascon Street. And his health got bad, and they had to put me on the bass. Mm-hmm. And I went with Charlie, with Tom Brown. We had Frank Keelan playing trumpet with us then. Yeah. Frank Keelan. Frank Keelan. I'll never forget. Well, Frank had a soft way of blowing that trumpet, you know, with that mute. And he didn't hear all that loud, blasting way of blowing trumpet. He was soft. But he could play. And we had trumpet, mandolin, two guitars, and a bass. No drum.
